trace.title: HTTP proxy
trace.detail: Nginx can accept HTTP traffic and proxy it to application servers, serve suitable static content, and enforce selected request/timeout rules. It is not a database pool or application permission layer. Managed ALB/CDN choices may cover some needs differently.

trace.title: Follow one item
trace.detail:
Follow HTTP headers/body/timeouts through the proxy, then follow one database transaction through both client and server pools. Count application processes/pools and observe queued versus active DB work.

Test a feature relying on connection/session state before selecting transaction pooling. Do not infer compatibility from one simple SELECT.

trace.title: Try the failure
trace.detail: Adding more pools can create more waiting layers. A proxy can buffer or time out large requests differently from the app. Session assumptions can break under a different pooling mode.
